vrf_convention: 100k selected final-arm FreeOracle convention; discovery, gradients, probability characterization and unselected arms are audit-only

local_control_saturation.high: median local ceiling <= 0.03 and zero states > 0.1

representation_mismatch.high: proposal coordinates omit a frozen event-defining variable, or dynamically distinct labels overlap in proposal-controlled coordinates in >=12 states
representation_mismatch.medium: topology labels are not explicit proposal conditioning variables but remain deterministically recoverable in proposal coordinates
representation_mismatch.low: event predicate and topology separation are fully defined in the proposal-controlled static coordinates

static_mixture_multimodality.high: at least 12 states have >=3 variance-mass topology modes with only 2 components and median K=3 versus K=2 weighted-SSE reduction >=0.20
static_mixture_multimodality.medium: either the topology/component count mismatch or the SSE condition holds

path_stage_dependence.high: stored stage variables separate high variance mass materially earlier than terminal variables in >=12 states
path_stage_dependence.medium: path variables exist but evidence is inconsistent
path_stage_dependence.low: the frozen benchmark event is a static latent-state predicate and no path process is part of its definition
path_stage_dependence.not_identifiable: event is path-defined but required path metadata are absent

benchmark_regime_dependence.high: abs Spearman(log event probability, log ceiling VRF) >=0.70 and at least one observed less-extreme state reaches VRF >0.1
benchmark_regime_dependence.medium: abs Spearman correlation >=0.50 without an observed efficient-regime transition

localized_coverage_only.high: severe coverage flags occur in >=12 states

route_rule: select a unique high-evidence mechanism; use R5 when multiple high mechanisms cannot be separated or no mechanism is high
